title: Abraham's Grill Hut: TT$175 Restaurant Week seafood package
summary: A seafood-focused Restaurant Week package for one is TT$175 including taxes at this Cunupia spot.
description: Abraham's Grill Hut's official Trinidad & Tobago Restaurant Week menu lists a TT$175 Flavour Affair package. Its Seafood Affair serves one; the organizer says taxes are included. The special is offered during Restaurant Week, September 25 to October 4, 2026.
